semantic_findings: The body is a guarded object-construction sequence: resolve one argument word through a helper that may write it back, obtain a per-call result from a manager obtained from a zero-argument accessor, bail out twice, otherwise build and configure an object through six virtual slots of a pointer the receiver holds, hand it to a second helper, and conditionally cache it in the receiver.

The two 32-bit stack words are used DIFFERENTLY and the difference is observable: entry_ESP+0x4 is passed by value to 0x00c0c5b0 AND by address, so the resolved value reaches the manager's +0x40 and the prototyper's +0x08 while the original reaches the prototyper's +0x40; entry_ESP+0x8 is only ever the third argument of 0x00c10250.

evidence_dispatch.classify_sites reads all seven indirect transfers as VTABLE_SLOT and the source's six declared slot displacements are byte-identical to the machine's six, so the two sides of VIRTUAL DISPATCH are directly comparable rather than merely adjacent.

The two +0x40 dispatches are provably on TWO DIFFERENT tables (0x00c12340 reads the table of what 0x0067cb20 returned; 0x00c123ac reads the table of receiver+0xb54), so the reconstruction declares two distinct vtable types rather than collapsing them.

PACK CONFLICT, RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF THE LISTING: the derived ABI's stack_arguments enumerates two slots totalling 8 bytes while its own cleanup.bytes says 12, and it records the cause in abstained_because ('flow_not_modelled: the linear ESP walk ends at +32'). Its slot keys come from that walk, which mis-attributes 0x00c1237d's CMP byte ptr [ESP+0x1c] to entry_ESP+0x8 instead of +0xc. Four PUSHes is 0x10 and RET 0xc says 12 bytes independently, so three arguments is the reading the bytes support.

PACK CONFLICT, RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF THE LISTING: the derived ABI's return_register is ST0 with return_semantics float_or_x87_in_ST0, derived from the mere presence of an x87 instruction. The FLDZ at 0x00c1238a is matched by FSTP float ptr [ESP] at 0x00c12392, so the x87 stack is empty before either RET and EAX carries the result on every exit. The record's return.type is null, so it makes no competing type claim.

It also renders 0x00c1237d's byte flag as unaff_BP, the register saved at 0x00c12311. No decompiler output is imported as a claim in this package.

unresolved_questions: Nothing has run the original process for this target: there is no trace, no differential capture and no runtime evidence anywhere in this repository, so the model test is a static model of the listing and not a comparison against the game.

What 0x00c0c5b0 writes through its aliasing out-parameter is not knowable from this body. The reconstruction models the alias and proves the two +0x40 dispatches are reached with different values when it writes, but the value itself is the callee's.
Whether the two +0x40 dispatches are the same method on two objects or two unrelated methods: the listing shows two tables and a shared displacement, and nothing more.
The concrete subtypes behind receiver+0xb54 and behind 0x0067cb20's return, and the sizes of either. No MSVC RTTI survives in this binary and no record names a class.
Whether 0x0067cb20's return is ever null. The body dereferences it at 0x00c12340 with no test, so this package invents no null case for it.
The exact receiver size. 0xe88+4 is a floor from the store, not a measurement, and the model test only asserts that nothing past it is written.
